description: This file defines the ContactHelper class, which provides utility methods for accessing and manipulating contact mechanism data related to parties in the OFBiz framework. It includes methods to retrieve contact mechanisms by various criteria and to format credit card information.

classes.name: ContactHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to retrieve and format contact mechanism data related to parties, such as contact details, contact mechanism types, and formatting credit card info.

methods.name: getContactMech
methods.description: Retrieves contact mechanisms associated with a specified party, optionally filtered by contact mechanism purpose and type, with an option to include or exclude old records.

methods.name: getContactMechByType
methods.description: Retrieves contact mechanisms for a party filtered by contact mechanism type, with an option to include or exclude old records.

methods.name: getContactMechByPurpose
methods.description: Retrieves contact mechanisms for a party filtered by contact mechanism purpose, with an option to include or exclude old records.

methods.name: formatCreditCard
methods.description: Formats credit card information into a string showing card type, last four digits, and expiration date.
